about.title: Hi, I'm Iván Paniagua Sánchez 👋
details: As a Web Development graduate and current Multiplatform Development student, I have cultivated a mindset oriented towards technical problem-solving. My expertise ranges from dynamic UI design with React to robust backend systems in Java and PHP. 🚀
I am a strong advocate for continuous learning and adaptability. My current goal is to apply my analytical skills to high-impact projects, collaborating in environments that challenge my limits. 🛠️

projects.title: World Countries & Weather
projects.description: A comprehensive application allowing users to search and explore data for over 250 countries. It integrates the OpenWeatherMap API to display real-time weather for capital cities. Built with React, Axios, and deployed on Vercel using secure environment variables.

projects.title: Interactive Pokedex
projects.description: A modern web application that allows you to explore a list of Pokémon, view their basic data such as image, ID, and types, and enjoy an interactive and responsive interface. Developed using React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, fetching data from PokeAPI.

projects.title: Feedloop
projects.description: Feedloop is a web application where team members can send anonymous or identified feedback to each other. Ideal for collaborative work environments, remote teams, or startups. Includes admin panels, trend tracking, and user management.

projects.title: FlowSweet
projects.description: Florist website developed with React and Tailwind CSS. Features a modern and responsive design, including pages like Home, About, and Contact. The project is deployed on GitHub Pages.

projects.title: FullStackOpen Exercises
projects.description: Central repository containing exercises from the FullStackOpen course by the University of Helsinki. Covers advanced React, Node.js, state management, and full-stack architecture.

projects.title: Anubis Gaming
projects.description: Video game sales website developed with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and MySQL. Includes a chatbot named THOT, a mini-game called MEHEN, user authentication system, and a store with a cart and coin system. Technologies like Node.js, Express, and AJAX were used.

projects.title: Anubis Gaming 2.0
projects.description: Improved version of the Anubis Gaming project, applying knowledge of the React framework and Node.js with Express as a backend server.

projects.title: Tic-Tac-Toe
projects.description: Classic Tic-Tac-Toe game developed with pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, without external frameworks or libraries. Features a two-player local mode.
